note: LOAD-BEARING asset paths referenced from OUTSIDE this repo: device-private launcher tiles (phone localStorage) and installed PWAs point at these URLs. No grep of this repo can find those references, so deleting any of these silently breaks a phone's icon or app identity. Run `node scripts/check-protected-assets.mjs` before any commit that deletes or renames files. Removing a path from this list requires Eric's explicit sign-off.
